title: Automated ICD-O-3 Coding of Real-World Pathology Reports Using Self-Hosted Large Language Models

abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical text processing, their real-world application in self-hosted clinical settings remains underexplored. Here, we evaluated five state-of-the-art self-hosted LLMs for …
